title: "LIQPLAT baseline population table"
date: 2026-08-20
format:

    toc: true

  warning: false

---

The baseline table is descriptive and uses the ITT assignment defined by
random selection for invitation. Missing covariates remain visible as
missing; no imputation or zero conversion is performed here.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "population_baseline_table"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "01-population"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
table_path <- file.path(result_dir, "baseline-characteristics.parquet")
figure_path <- file.path(result_dir, "baseline-age.svg")
input_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                        "analysis-cohort.parquet")
if (!file.exists(input_path)) stop("Baseline table requires the built analysis cohort.")
input_paths <- c(input_path, schema_domain_path(config, "cohort_follow_up"))
output_paths <- c(table_path, figure_path)
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "01-population", "03-baseline-table.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  baseline_table <- read_result_table(table_path)
} else {
  cohort <- read_result_table(input_path)
  require_public_columns(cohort, c("id", "tx"), "baseline cohort")
  tx <- validate_binary(cohort$tx, "tx", allow_missing = FALSE)
  cohort$group <- factor(tx, levels = c(1, 0),
                         labels = c("Selected for invitation", "External comparator"))
  continuous <- intersect(c("age", "albumin", "c_reactive_protein"), names(cohort))
  categorical <- intersect(c("gender", "ecog_fstcnt", "diagnosis"), names(cohort))
  rows <- list()
  for (column_name in continuous) {
    values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(cohort[[column_name]])))
    for (group_name in levels(cohort$group)) {
      group_values <- values[cohort$group == group_name]
      observed <- group_values[is.finite(group_values)]
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        variable = column_name,
        level = "median [Q1, Q3]",
        group = group_name,
        n = length(observed),
        denominator = length(group_values),
        missing = sum(!is.finite(group_values)),
        estimate = if (length(observed) == 0L) NA_real_ else stats::median(observed),
        q1 = if (length(observed) == 0L) NA_real_ else stats::quantile(observed, 0.25),
        q3 = if (length(observed) == 0L) NA_real_ else stats::quantile(observed, 0.75),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  for (column_name in categorical) {
    values <- as.character(cohort[[column_name]])
    values[is.na(values) | !nzchar(trimws(values))] <- "Missing"
    for (group_name in levels(cohort$group)) {
      group_values <- values[cohort$group == group_name]
      levels_observed <- sort(unique(group_values), method = "radix")
      for (level_name in levels_observed) {
        n <- sum(group_values == level_name)
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
          variable = column_name,
          level = level_name,
          group = group_name,
          n = n,
          denominator = length(group_values),
          missing = if (identical(level_name, "Missing")) n else 0L,
          estimate = if (length(group_values) == 0L) NA_real_ else n / length(group_values),
          q1 = NA_real_,
          q3 = NA_real_,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }
  if (length(rows) == 0L) {
    baseline_table <- data.frame(
      variable = character(), level = character(), group = character(),
      n = integer(), denominator = integer(), missing = integer(),
      estimate = numeric(), q1 = numeric(), q3 = numeric(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    baseline_table <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  }
  rownames(baseline_table) <- NULL
  write_module_table(baseline_table, table_path)
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required for the baseline figure.")
  }
  if ("age" %in% names(cohort)) {
    age_data <- data.frame(age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(cohort$age))),
                           group = cohort$group)
    age_data <- age_data[is.finite(age_data$age), , drop = FALSE]
    plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(age_data, ggplot2::aes(age, fill = group)) +
      ggplot2::geom_histogram(alpha = 0.5, bins = 20, position = "identity") +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "Age at random selection (years)", y = "Patients", fill = NULL) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  } else {
    plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Age at random selection (years)", y = "Patients",
      subtitle = "Age is not available in the public cohort interface."
    ) + ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  }
  assert_artifact_path(figure_path)
  ggplot2::ggsave(figure_path, plot = plot, width = 8, height = 4, units = "in")
  finalize_module_checkpoint(
    stage_id = stage_id,
    checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
    input_paths = input_paths,
    output_paths = output_paths,
    config = config,
    metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                    status = "built"),
    code_paths = here::here("analysis", "01-population", "03-baseline-table.qmd")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: baseline-table
#| tbl-cap: "Baseline characteristics by invitation assignment"

baseline_table |>
  transform(estimate = round(estimate, 4)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
